ex.s: Every weekend this is “Wales” premier comedy club where having a great time is the order for both audiences and comedy stars alike.
ex.t: 每个周末这里都是"威尔士"顶级喜剧俱乐部，观众和喜剧明星都能在这里度过美好时光。

ex.s: Indian Premier League (cricket, India) Cricket is from England but has become as Indian as saris and curry.
ex.t: 印度板球超级联赛（板球，印度）板球起源于英国，但已经变得像纱丽和咖喱一样具有印度特色。

ex.s: The Indian Premier League has the largest audience of all cricket leagues in the world and is the sixth most-watched sports league in the world.
ex.t: 印度板球超级联赛拥有全世界所有板球联赛中最多的观众，也是全球第六大收视率最高的体育联赛。

ex.s: Bakeries, fast-food joints, butcher shops, cafes, and restaurants everywhere provide some of the premier food experiences in the world.
ex.t: 各地的面包店、快餐店、肉铺、咖啡馆和餐厅，提供了世界上一些顶级的饮食体验。

ex.t: 它是20世纪首屈一指的建筑之一。

ex.s: Thailand is a premier holiday destination, attracting tourists from all over the world.
ex.t: 泰国是一个顶级的度假胜地，吸引着来自世界各地的游客。
